### As I Look Up to the Heavens
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/as-i-look-up-to-the-heavens.html
Passage: Psalm 19:1
Points:
- Gazing at the skies reveals the fingerprints and craftsmanship of the Creator.
- Stargazing provides a sacred pause from daily stress to refocus on God.
- The vast scale of the cosmos humbles us while reminding us of God's intimate care.
- Contemplating the night sky quiets restless minds and points to Christ, the light of the world.

### God Speaks through His Creation
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-may-21-2018.html
Passage: Psalm 19:1-6
Points:
- The universe continually and boldly proclaims the majesty of its Creator.
- Nature's testimony is consistent day and night, wordless yet understood across the globe.
- The precision, path, and warmth of the sun show God's sustaining power.
- Creation leaves humanity without excuse, establishing accountability to the sovereign ruler of all.

### The Paradox of Freedom in Christ
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-july-10-2023.html
Passage: Psalm 19:7-8, 11
Points:
- God's law is not an outdated burden but a source of restoration, joy, and wisdom.
- While believers are not saved by the law, they live out God's will through it.
- Disobedience creates spiritual bondage, whereas true freedom is found in loving obedience.
- Walking in God's commands revives the soul and carries great spiritual reward.

### May the Words
Author: Trevin Wax
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/trevin-wax/may-the-words/
Passage: Psalm 19:14
Points:
- The verse is an ongoing prayer of dependence asking God to guard speech and thoughts.
- Careless speech easily spills out of the heart unless daily spiritual discipline is maintained.
- Meditating on God's truth aligns the heart's default state away from self-centeredness.
- The Christian aim is not eloquence or applause, but inner thoughts and outer words pleasing to God.
- God acts both as the sheltering rock and the redeemer who forgives and renews.
